data.long_meaning: Ridhvansh is a Hindu name for boys that means 'descendant of Ridhva'. Ridhva is a Sanskrit name that means 'ruler', 'lord'. Therefore, Ridhvansh can be interpreted as 'descendant of the ruler'. This name is often given to a boy who is destined to rule or lead in some way. The name Ridhvansh carries the meaning “Descendant of Ridhva” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Ridhvansh usually hope their child will grow to embody descendant of ridhva and live with faith, good character and purpose.
